name: entra-id-auth-test-harness
description: Fills copies of skills/entra-id-auth/templates with placeholder values and runs their tests, so CI proves the templates work without touching a real tenant, project or site.

scripts.test: bash fill.sh && vitest run && tsc -p .work/site-listed && tsc -p .work/entra-group && tsc -p .work/site-group && tsc -p .work/entra-listed && tsc -p .work/site-home
scripts.typecheck: bash fill.sh && tsc -p .work/site-listed && tsc -p .work/entra-group && tsc -p .work/site-group && tsc -p .work/entra-listed && tsc -p .work/site-home
